title: feat(spec,plugin-security,rest,client): a record-scoped field projection judges a `when` lock on the stored row
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBFrHTwT2queiHnTbzxnSn3Y)_

Part of #26594

Ruling-ref: 6457467702
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: updated here — content/docs/permissions/field-level-security.mdx (the readers bullet now names the record-scoped projection); skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md names no reader of the lock, so no skills/** edit (this PR is not governed)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:新增「按某条记录」的字段投影 `GET /api/v1/data/{object}/{id}/field-access`(SDK `client.data.fieldAccess`),回答这条记录上哪些字段可读、哪些可写;协议里 `when` 的描述同步改为:无行读取方维持按锁上报,按记录的投影按存储行判断。
- 为什么改:裁决 B。带 `when` 的字段锁(如「批准后锁定」)在草稿上服务端允许写,但表单读的是无行的 `/auth/me/permissions`,只能按锁显示,用户被告知不能改其实能改的字段。
- 风险与回滚:纯新增,旧接口一字节不变;可写判断直接调用写闸本身(`computeForbiddenFieldWrites`),不存在第二套求值;读不到的记录回答与读记录接口相同的 404。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts` 的 `getRecordFieldAccess`、`security-plugin-field-readers.ts` 的 `readRowForbiddenWrites`、`packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts` 的新路由。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/record-field-access-when.dogfood.test.ts`,预期 7/7 通过(草稿上 summary 可写、已批准行上锁定,逐字段与 PATCH 结果一致)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**The door: a record-addressed route**, `GET /api/v1/data/:object/:id/field-access`, answering `{ success: true, data: { object, recordId, readable, editable } }` (`GetRecordFieldAccessResponseSchema`). Why a route and not a parameter:

- The record form does not read a field projection today. Its edit dialog reads `/auth/me/permissions` (`MePermissionsProvider` → `checkField` → `fieldWriteGate` in `ui/packages/plugin-form`), and no HTTP route serves `getReadableFields` / `getWritableFields` at all. So there was no projection read to add a parameter to, and the ruling keeps `/auth/me/permissions` row-less.
- A record id belongs in the path the data family already addresses records by (`/data/:object/:id/clone`, `/shares`). The route reads the record first through the same `getData` call `GET /data/:object/:id` makes, so a missing row and a row the caller cannot read answer that route's own 404 (same code, same body), and a refused read answers its 403. The projection never says more than the read.

**One judge.** `editable` is the field-level write gate itself, **`SecurityPlugin#computeForbiddenFieldWrites`** (body in `security-plugin-object-inputs.ts`), the function step 2.5 of the engine middleware throws from and the one `canWriteObject` asks. The record-scoped answer asks it for an update of the stored row naming every field, with the row read as the caller reads it (`readRowById`, the reader the gate's own pre-image comes from through `getCallerPreImage`). The gate refuses per field, so the fields it names are exactly the ones a by-id update of that row may not write. Sets, posture and the delegator intersection come from `resolveProjectionFieldMask`, the derivation the gate's inputs and the object-wide projections already share. Nothing evaluates `when` a second time.

**Why `readable` comes from the read mask, not from `/auth/me/permissions`.** `readable` is `getReadableFields`' answer, computed from the same mask (`computeReadableFields` over the mask already resolved for this call). Reads are judged row-blind by contract (`when` reaches the edit vote only), so the row adds nothing there. The read mask is what the middleware's result masker actually applies: it folds a field's `requiredPermissions`, intersects a delegator's mask, and keeps a partially masked field as a served column. `/auth/me/permissions` is a raw merge of the sets' `fields` entries and applies none of those, so it can disagree with what the record read returns.

Files:

- `packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts`: the `when` description names the record-scoped projection as the reader that judges the row; the row-less readers (`/auth/me/permissions`, the object-wide field projections, the write preview) keep reporting the lock.
- `packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.ts`: optional `ISecurityService.getRecordFieldAccess(object, recordId, context)` → answer, `null` (no row for this caller), or `undefined` (no answer).
- `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`: `GetRecordFieldAccessResponseSchema` and its `GetRecordFieldAccessResponse` / `GetRecordFieldAccessResponseParsed` aliases (ADR-0122). Regenerated artifacts: api-surface, export-origins, declaration-map, authorable-surface, json-schema manifest, references docs, strictness-ledger count (`api/` 447 → 448).
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security`: `getRecordFieldAccess` on the plugin and on the registered `security` service; the projection mask gains `readRowForbiddenWrites(row)`, the gate call above. `getWritableFields` and every other row-less reader are unchanged.
- `packages/rest`: the route in `data-action-routes.ts` with an empty closed query-parameter set (`RECORD_FIELD_ACCESS_PARAMS`), 501 when no security service offers the method, ledgered `sdk` with `responseSchema`.
- `packages/client`: `data.fieldAccess(object, id)`.
- `content/docs/permissions/field-level-security.mdx`: the readers bullet.
- Changesets: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/plugin-security`, `@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/client`, each minor with both declaration lines.

No ADR-0087 marker: nothing stored changes meaning. PR 2 (`Fixes #26594`) makes the ui record form's edit dialog read this route; it lands after this one.

## Tests

- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/record-field-access-when.dogfood.test.ts` (real HTTP + security stack, fixture `fixtures/record-field-access-fixture.ts`, `rfa_contract.summary` locked `when: "status in ['approved']"`, `ref_no` locked unconditionally, a private `rfa_memo`):
  - measure (the card's symptom, kept as its record): `/auth/me/permissions` reports `summary` `{ readable: true, editable: false }`, while `PATCH summary` answers 200 on the draft and 403 on the approved row;
  - on the draft the projection lists `summary` editable and `ref_no` not; on the approved row neither;
  - field by field on both rows, `editable.includes(field)` equals the PATCH verdict (200 vs 403), allowed and refused;
  - a private row the member cannot read, and a missing id: same status (404) and the same body as `GET /data/rfa_memo/:id`;
  - row-less reader unchanged; `?fields=` refused with 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`.
  - The answer is parsed against `GetRecordFieldAccessResponseSchema` on the real mount (the ledger's conformance coverage).
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin.test.ts` (`[#26594] getRecordFieldAccess`): unlocked on an unnamed row, locked on a named row, equal to the middleware's step 2.5 verdict for every field on both rows, `null` for an absent or invisible row, `getWritableFields` unchanged and reading no row, `undefined` for an unresolvable schema, system context, and the registered service answering from the method. The member pin gains `getRecordFieldAccess: 'optional'`.
- `packages/rest/src/record-field-access-route.test.ts`: relay and arguments, the read refusal answered without asking the service, a row lost between reads answering the read path's 404, 501 without the method, and the closed parameter set (400, neither the read nor the service called).
- `packages/client/src/client.test.ts`: URL, method and envelope unwrap.

## Acceptance notes

- The measure legs ran on this branch, not on a separate `origin/main` build. They exercise `/auth/me/permissions` (`plugin-hono-server`) and the step 2.5 write gate, and this diff changes neither code path. The ablation below is the main-equivalent reading of the projection itself.
- `readable` is the object-wide read projection by contract, not a row judgement, and says so in the schema.

## Verification

Head `3af86eab0` (main `cb8988ee1` merged in; the tree the runs below read).

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 109 derived families, each run and its exit recorded; `--ran` reconciliation: 109 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. All 109 exit 0 on the merged tree. (On the tree before the last main merge, `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered exit 3, missing `dist/` for packages this PR does not touch; built, both reran exit 0.)
- Under `os-verify-lock`, after the last merge: `@objectstack/plugin-security` test, `@objectstack/rest` test, `@objectstack/client` test, `@objectstack/dogfood` typecheck, and the dogfood test above, all exit 0; `@objectstack/spec` `check:generated` exit 0.
- Under `os-verify-lock`, before the last merge: `@objectstack/spec` test (22130 passed) and typecheck, `@objectstack/plugin-security` test (5056 passed) and typecheck, `@objectstack/rest` test (6552 passed) and typecheck, `@objectstack/client` test (679 passed) and typecheck, all exit 0.
- Ablation: with the pre-image the projection hands the gate replaced by a null row (marker confirmed in `dist/`), the dogfood file goes 2 red / 5 green: the draft unlock and the field-by-field equality fail, as they should. Restored, the marker is absent from every rebuilt `dist/` file and the file is 7/7.
